name: Musical Chairs
description: Classic musical chair game with themed music
fullDescription: A timeless party game where children walk around chairs while music plays. When the music stops, everyone must find a seat. Perfect for any theme with themed music selection.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up chairs in a circle, one less than participants
2. Play music and have children walk around chairs
3. Stop music randomly - children must sit
4. Remove one chair and one child each round
5. Continue until one winner remains
hostScript: Welcome to our musical adventure! When the music plays, dance around the chairs. When it stops, find your seat quickly but safely!

name: Treasure Hunt
description: Themed treasure hunt with clues and prizes
fullDescription: An exciting adventure where children follow themed clues to find hidden treasures. Can be adapted for any theme and venue type with age-appropriate puzzles.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Hide treasures in various locations
2. Create themed clues leading to each location
3. Give first clue to each team
4. Guide teams through the hunt
5. Celebrate when treasures are found
hostScript: Ahoy treasure hunters! Your adventure awaits. Follow the clues carefully and work as a team to find the hidden treasures!

name: Pin the Tail on the Donkey
description: Classic game adapted for party theme
fullDescription: Traditional blindfolded game where children try to pin a tail on a donkey poster. Can be themed as 'Pin the Crown on the Princess', 'Pin the Cape on the Superhero', etc.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Hang poster at child-appropriate height
2. Blindfold each child in turn
3. Spin child gently 2-3 times
4. Guide them toward poster
5. Mark their attempt and continue
hostScript: Time for our classic game! Put on the blindfold and try to pin the tail in just the right spot. Everyone cheer for our brave volunteer!

name: Face Painting Station
description: Professional face painting with themed designs
fullDescription: Transform children into their favorite characters with safe, washable face paints. Popular designs include butterflies, superheroes, animals, and theme-specific characters.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up painting station with good lighting
2. Display design options for children
3. Paint one child at a time
4. Allow paint to dry before child moves
5. Provide mirrors for children to see results
hostScript: Step right up to our magical transformation station! Choose your favorite design and we'll turn you into a character from your dreams!

name: Balloon Animals
fullDescription: A skilled balloon artist creates amazing balloon sculptures for children. From simple dogs and swords to complex flowers and characters, each child receives a custom creation.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up balloon station with pump
2. Take requests from children
3. Create balloon animals one by one
4. Explain the process to engaged children
5. Ensure each child gets a balloon creation
hostScript: Welcome to our balloon magic corner! Tell me what animal or shape you'd like, and I'll twist it into existence right before your eyes!

name: Duck Pond Game
description: Pick a floating duck to win prizes
fullDescription: Children select rubber ducks from a small pool, each with a number on the bottom corresponding to different prizes. Everyone wins something in this classic carnival game.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up pool and fill with water
2. Float numbered ducks in pool
3. Let each child pick a duck
4. Check number and award corresponding prize
5. Return duck to pool for next child
hostScript: Step up to our lucky duck pond! Pick any duck you like, and let's see what wonderful prize you've won today!

name: Ring Toss
description: Toss rings onto pegs to win points
fullDescription: Classic carnival game where children throw rings to land them on pegs or bottles. Can be themed with different colored rings and special targets for bonus points.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up ring toss pegs at appropriate distance
2. Give each child 3-5 rings
3. Keep score of successful tosses
4. Award points for different targets
5. Give prizes based on total score
hostScript: Test your aim at our ring toss challenge! Take your time, aim carefully, and see how many rings you can land on the pegs!

name: Limbo Contest
fullDescription: Children take turns dancing under a horizontal bar that gets progressively lower. Great for building flexibility and having fun with music and movement.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up limbo bar at starting height
2. Play upbeat limbo music
3. Have children line up and take turns
4. Lower bar after each round
5. Continue until one winner remains
hostScript: How low can you go? It's time for our limbo challenge! Dance your way under the bar, but don't let it touch you!

name: Sack Race
description: Hop to the finish line in burlap sacks
fullDescription: Children climb into large sacks and hop their way to the finish line. This classic outdoor game promotes coordination and provides lots of laughs.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Mark start and finish lines
2. Give each child a sack
3. Have children step into sacks at start line
4. Start race on count of three
5. Cheer everyone to finish line
hostScript: Ready for a hopping good time? Step into your sacks, hold them up high, and let's see who can hop to victory!

name: Water Balloon Toss
fullDescription: Pairs of children toss water balloons back and forth, taking a step back after each successful catch. The last pair with an intact balloon wins!
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Fill water balloons in advance
2. Pair up children as partners
3. Start with partners close together
4. After each successful catch, step back
5. Last pair with intact balloon wins
hostScript: Partner up for our splashing water balloon challenge! Start close together and see how far apart you can get without popping your balloon!

name: Freeze Dance
description: Dance and freeze when music stops
fullDescription: Children dance freely while music plays, but must freeze like statues when the music stops. Those who keep moving are out until the next round.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Clear dancing space
2. Start upbeat music
3. Encourage creative dancing
4. Stop music randomly
5. Continue until few dancers remain
hostScript: Let's get this dance party started! Dance however you want, but when the music stops, freeze like a statue!

name: Craft Making Station
fullDescription: Children create their own themed crafts to take home. Options include decorating picture frames, making friendship bracelets, or creating theme-specific art projects.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up craft stations with supplies
2. Demonstrate craft example
3. Help children with difficult steps
4. Allow creativity in decorating
5. Help children clean up and pack crafts
hostScript: Welcome to our creative corner! Today we're making special keepsakes you can treasure forever. Let your imagination run wild!

name: Magic Show
fullDescription: A magician performs age-appropriate tricks and illusions, often involving audience participation. Children are amazed by disappearing objects, card tricks, and magical transformations.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up performance area
2. Gather children in semicircle
3. Perform 4-6 magic tricks
4. Include audience participation
5. End with grand finale trick
hostScript: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, prepare to be amazed! Watch closely as we create magic right before your very eyes!

name: Puppet Show
fullDescription: Hand puppets or marionettes tell stories and interact with the audience. Children can participate by answering questions, singing along, or even controlling puppets themselves.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up puppet theater
2. Arrange seating for audience
3. Perform 15-20 minute show
4. Include audience interaction
5. Allow children to meet puppets afterward
hostScript: Welcome to our magical puppet theater! Our puppet friends have exciting stories to tell, and they might need your help along the way!

name: Bubble Play Zone
fullDescription: Multiple bubble-making activities including bubble machines, giant bubble wands, and bubble solution for endless popping fun. Perfect for outdoor parties.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up bubble machines around area
2. Fill with bubble solution
3. Distribute bubble wands to children
4. Show how to make giant bubbles
5. Supervise and refill as needed
hostScript: Welcome to our bubble wonderland! Chase bubbles, pop them, and try to make the biggest bubble you can imagine!

name: Obstacle Course
fullDescription: A series of physical challenges including crawling through tunnels, jumping over objects, balancing beams, and completing tasks. Can be themed to match party.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up obstacle course stations
2. Demonstrate each obstacle
3. Time each child's attempt
4. Encourage and cheer participants
5. Award completion certificates
hostScript: Welcome to our adventure obstacle course! Navigate through each challenge, have fun, and remember - everyone who finishes is a winner!

name: Karaoke Corner
fullDescription: Children take turns singing their favorite songs with microphone and backing tracks. Include both popular children's songs and current hits appropriate for the age group.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up karaoke equipment
2. Create performance area
3. Let children choose songs
4. Encourage audience participation
5. Take photos/videos for parents
hostScript: It's time to shine like a star! Pick your favorite song and show us your amazing singing talent. Don't forget to put on a great show!

name: Story Time Circle
fullDescription: A storyteller reads age-appropriate books or tells stories related to the party theme. Children sit in a circle and participate through questions, predictions, and acting out parts.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Create comfortable circle seating
2. Choose theme-appropriate stories
3. Use voices and expressions
4. Ask interactive questions
5. Encourage participation
hostScript: Gather 'round for an amazing story adventure! I need good listeners and brave participants to help bring our story to life!

name: Dance Party
fullDescription: High-energy dance session with popular children's music, dance games, and group choreography. Perfect for getting everyone moving and having fun together.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up sound system and lights
2. Clear large dance space
3. Start with warm-up songs
4. Teach simple group dances
5. Free dance time to favorites
hostScript: Let's get this party started! Show me your best dance moves, follow along with the group dances, and let's make this the best dance party ever!

name: Cupcake Decorating
fullDescription: Children receive plain cupcakes and various decorating supplies to create their own edible masterpieces. Great for combining creativity with a sweet treat.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up decorating stations
2. Give each child a plain cupcake
3. Demonstrate decorating techniques
4. Let children create freely
5. Help with cleanup
hostScript: Welcome to our cupcake decorating station! Create the most beautiful and delicious cupcake you can imagine. The only rule is to have fun!

name: Movie Screening
fullDescription: Watch age-appropriate movies or video clips related to the party theme. Create a cozy theater atmosphere with dimmed lights and comfortable seating.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up viewing area with seating
2. Test audio/video equipment
3. Dim lights for theater atmosphere
4. Serve movie snacks
5. Monitor and engage children
hostScript: Welcome to our private movie theater! Get comfortable, grab some popcorn, and let's enjoy this special screening together!

name: Talent Show
fullDescription: Each child gets a chance to perform their special talent - singing, dancing, jokes, magic tricks, or any skill they want to share with the group.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up performance stage
2. Let children sign up for acts
3. Give each child 2-3 minutes
4. Encourage audience applause
5. Give everyone a participation award
hostScript: It's time for our amazing talent show! Everyone has something special to share. Let's cheer for each performer and celebrate all talents!

name: Relay Races
fullDescription: Various relay race challenges where teams compete in different activities - running, crawling, balancing objects, or theme-specific tasks.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Divide children into equal teams
2. Explain relay rules clearly
3. Set up relay course
4. Run multiple relay variations
5. Celebrate all teams
hostScript: Time for our exciting relay races! Work together as a team, cheer for your teammates, and remember that teamwork makes the dream work!

name: Science Experiments
fullDescription: Simple, safe science experiments that amaze children - volcano eruptions, color-changing liquids, floating objects, and other visual phenomena.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up experiment station safely
2. Demonstrate each experiment
3. Let children participate safely
4. Explain simple science concepts
5. Clean up thoroughly
hostScript: Welcome to our amazing science laboratory! Today we're going to create magic through science. Watch closely and prepare to be amazed!

name: Photo Booth
fullDescription: A decorated photo area with theme-related props, costumes, and backdrops where children can take fun pictures alone or in groups.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up backdrop and props
2. Arrange good lighting
3. Help children choose props
4. Take multiple shots of each group
5. Share photos with parents later
hostScript: Strike a pose at our photo booth! Choose your favorite props, make silly faces, and let's capture some amazing memories from today's party!

name: Parachute Games
fullDescription: Classic parachute activities where children hold the edges of a large colorful parachute and play various games - making waves, bouncing balls, and mushroom formations.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Spread parachute in open area
2. Have children space around edges
3. Start with gentle wave motions
4. Add balls for bouncing games
5. End with mushroom formation
hostScript: Everyone grab a handle of our magic parachute! Work together to make waves, bounce balls, and create amazing formations!

name: Costume Parade
fullDescription: Children dress up in theme-related costumes and participate in a fun parade or fashion show, showing off their outfits to admiring audience.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Help children with costume selection
2. Set up runway or parade route
3. Play upbeat music
4. Announce each child as they parade
5. Give everyone a special award
hostScript: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our amazing costume parade! Each child will walk the runway and show off their fantastic outfit!

name: Coloring Station
description: Themed coloring pages and art supplies
fullDescription: A quiet creative space with themed coloring pages, crayons, markers, and colored pencils where children can create art at their own pace.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up tables with art supplies
2. Distribute themed coloring pages
3. Help younger children as needed
4. Encourage creativity and compliment work
5. Help children take artwork home
hostScript: Welcome to our creative coloring corner! Choose your favorite picture and bring it to life with beautiful colors. There's no wrong way to color!

name: Giant Board Games
fullDescription: Life-sized versions of popular board games like Connect 4, Jenga, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Checkers where children become the game pieces.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up various giant games
2. Explain rules for each game
3. Help organize teams/players
4. Supervise fair play
5. Rotate children through games
hostScript: Welcome to our giant game zone! These are your favorite games made HUGE! Take turns and remember, the most important thing is having fun!

name: Scavenger Hunt
description: Find hidden items from a list
fullDescription: Children receive lists of items to find around the party area. Items can be theme-related objects, colors, or specific things hidden beforehand.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Hide items around area before party
2. Give each child/team a list
3. Set clear boundaries for hunting
4. Provide clues if children get stuck
5. Celebrate when items are found
hostScript: Detective time! You have a special list of items to find. Work as a team, look carefully, and see if you can find everything on your list!

name: Balloon Pop Games
fullDescription: Multiple balloon games including pop-the-balloon for prizes, balloon stomp competition, and sitting on balloons to pop them. Always fun and exciting!
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up different balloon stations
2. Blow up balloons with prizes inside
3. Explain safety rules clearly
4. Supervise all popping activities
5. Award prizes and clean up balloon pieces
hostScript: Welcome to our balloon popping extravaganza! There are prizes hidden in some balloons. Pop carefully and see what surprises await you!

name: Mini Golf
fullDescription: Set up a themed mini golf course using household items and creative obstacles. Each hole can relate to the party theme with fun challenges.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up 6-8 mini golf holes
2. Create theme-related obstacles
3. Give each child a scorecard
4. Help with scoring and rules
5. Award prizes for participation
hostScript: Welcome to our custom mini golf course! Each hole has a special challenge. Take your time, aim carefully, and have fun!

name: Cookie Decorating
fullDescription: Children receive plain sugar cookies in theme-related shapes and decorate them with icing, sprinkles, and other edible decorations.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up decorating stations
2. Give each child 2-3 cookies
3. Demonstrate decorating techniques
4. Let creativity flow freely
5. Package cookies for taking home
hostScript: Welcome to our cookie decorating bakery! Make these plain cookies beautiful and delicious. They're yours to take home and enjoy!

name: Water Sprinkler Fun
description: Running through sprinklers and water play
fullDescription: Set up sprinklers and water toys for children to run through and play in. Perfect for hot weather outdoor parties with lots of splashing fun.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up sprinklers in safe area
2. Test water pressure and coverage
3. Have towels ready nearby
4. Supervise water play safety
5. Help children dry off afterward
hostScript: It's time to cool off with our water sprinkler fun! Run through the water, splash around, and beat the heat while having a blast!

name: Lego Building Challenge
fullDescription: Children receive Lego sets or pieces and compete to build themed creations - towers, animals, vehicles, or free-form sculptures within time limits.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up building stations
2. Announce building challenge theme
3. Give time limit for building
4. Allow creativity and help as needed
5. Display and celebrate all creations
hostScript: Master builders, your challenge awaits! Use these Lego pieces to create something amazing. Let your imagination run wild and build something fantastic!

name: Cartoon Character Meet
description: Meet and greet with costumed characters
fullDescription: Popular cartoon or theme characters visit the party for photos, autographs, and interaction. Characters can lead activities and make the party extra special.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Character makes grand entrance
2. Individual photos with each child
3. Group activities led by character
4. Autograph signing session
5. Special goodbye from character
hostScript: Look who's here to join our party! It's [Character Name]! They want to meet each of you and take pictures together!

name: Pizza Making
fullDescription: Children create their own mini pizzas with provided dough, sauce, cheese, and toppings. Pizzas are baked and enjoyed as part of the party meal.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up pizza making stations
2. Give each child a dough portion
3. Demonstrate spreading sauce and cheese
4. Let children add favorite toppings
5. Bake pizzas and serve when ready
hostScript: Welcome to our pizza kitchen! Today you're the chef. Create your perfect pizza with your favorite toppings and we'll bake it fresh for you!

name: Animal Petting Zoo
description: Mini petting zoo with gentle animals
fullDescription: Bring in a mobile petting zoo with rabbits, guinea pigs, and other gentle animals for children to pet, hold, and learn about with supervision.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up animal enclosures safely
2. Brief children on gentle animal handling
3. Supervise all animal interactions
4. Teach children about each animal
5. Ensure proper cleanup and animal care
hostScript: Welcome to our special petting zoo! These animals are very gentle and friendly. Remember to be soft and kind when you pet them!

name: Sand Art Bottles
fullDescription: Children layer different colored sand in clear bottles to create beautiful rainbow patterns and designs they can take home as keepsakes.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up sand art station with supplies
2. Show children how to use funnels
3. Demonstrate layering techniques
4. Help create patterns with sticks
5. Cap bottles securely for taking home
hostScript: Create your own rainbow in a bottle! Layer the colored sand to make beautiful patterns. This special artwork is yours to keep forever!

name: Hula Hoop Contest
description: See who can hula hoop the longest
fullDescription: Children compete to see who can keep their hula hoop spinning the longest. Multiple rounds with different sized hoops for different ages.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Give each child an appropriate sized hoop
2. Show proper hula hooping technique
3. Start contest with music
4. Time how long each child lasts
5. Award prizes for effort and achievement
hostScript: Let's see those hips move! Keep that hula hoop spinning around your waist. Don't give up - everyone's doing great!

name: Friendship Bracelet Making
description: Create bracelets to give to friends
fullDescription: Children learn to make simple friendship bracelets using colorful threads, beads, and charms. They can make them for themselves or to give as gifts.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up bracelet making stations
2. Show basic braiding technique
3. Help children choose color combinations
4. Assist with difficult knots
5. Help tie finished bracelets
hostScript: Let's make special bracelets for our friends! Choose your favorite colors and patterns. These bracelets will remind you of our fun party!

name: Guess the Sound
fullDescription: Children listen to various recorded sounds or live sounds made behind a screen and try to guess what's making each noise. Great for developing listening skills.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up listening area with speaker
2. Play variety of mystery sounds
3. Give children time to guess each sound
4. Reveal answers with explanation
5. Award points for correct guesses
hostScript: Put on your detective ears! We're going to hear some mystery sounds. Listen carefully and see if you can figure out what's making each noise!

name: Tug of War
fullDescription: Two teams pull on opposite ends of a rope to see who can pull the other team across a center line. Great for teamwork and physical activity.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Mark center line clearly
2. Divide children into equal teams
3. Explain safety rules
4. Start pulling contest
5. Celebrate both teams' effort
hostScript: Time for the ultimate team challenge! Grab the rope, work together, and see which team has the strongest pull! Remember, teamwork wins!

name: Memory Game Circle
fullDescription: Children sit in a circle and play memory games like 'I'm going on a picnic and I'm bringing...' where each child adds an item and repeats all previous items.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Arrange children in comfortable circle
2. Explain memory game rules
3. Start with simple theme
4. Help children remember sequences
5. Celebrate everyone's participation
hostScript: Let's test our amazing memories! Listen carefully to what everyone says before you, then add your own item to our growing list!

name: Paper Airplane Contest
fullDescription: Children learn to fold different paper airplane designs and compete to see whose plane flies the farthest, stays in air longest, or performs best tricks.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Teach basic paper airplane folding
2. Let children decorate their planes
3. Set up flight testing area
4. Hold various flying contests
5. Award prizes for different categories
hostScript: Welcome to our aviation academy! Fold your paper airplane carefully, decorate it however you like, and let's see how far it can soar!

name: Simon Says
fullDescription: Classic game where children must follow instructions only when preceded by 'Simon Says.' Great for listening skills and following directions.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Gather children in open area
2. Explain 'Simon Says' rules clearly
3. Start with simple commands
4. Gradually increase complexity
5. Let children take turns being 'Simon'
hostScript: Listen very carefully! Only follow my instructions if I say 'Simon Says' first. If I don't say it, don't move!

name: Charades for Kids
description: Act out animals, movies, and actions
fullDescription: Age-appropriate charades where children act out animals, cartoon characters, or simple actions while others guess. Great for creativity and expression.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Prepare age-appropriate charade cards
2. Explain charades rules
3. Start with easier animals/actions
4. Time each performance
5. Encourage creative acting
hostScript: Time to become amazing actors! Pick a card and act it out without talking. Everyone else, watch carefully and guess what they're showing us!

name: Musical Statues
fullDescription: Similar to freeze dance but with emphasis on creative statue poses. Children dance to music and when it stops, they freeze in creative statue positions.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Start upbeat music
2. Encourage creative dancing
3. Stop music suddenly
4. Children freeze in statue poses
5. Compliment creative poses
hostScript: Dance like nobody's watching! But when the music stops, become the most creative statue you can imagine. Hold that pose!

name: Story Building Circle
fullDescription: Children sit in a circle and build a story together, with each child adding one sentence before passing to the next person. Creates hilarious and creative stories.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Arrange children in circle
2. Start with story prompt
3. Each child adds one sentence
4. Continue around circle multiple times
5. End with satisfying conclusion
hostScript: We're going to create an amazing story together! Each person adds one sentence, then we pass to the next person. Let's see what adventure we create!

name: Hot Potato
description: Pass the object before music stops
fullDescription: Children sit in a circle and quickly pass an object (potato, ball, etc.) around while music plays. Whoever has it when music stops is out, but gets to help with the next round.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Arrange children in circle
2. Start music and begin passing object
3. Stop music randomly
4. Child with object steps out temporarily
5. Continue until few children remain
hostScript: Quick! Pass the hot potato before it burns your hands! When the music stops, don't be caught holding it!

name: Dress Up Relay
description: Race to put on costumes and accessories
fullDescription: Teams race to put on various costume pieces, run to a designated spot, take them off, and pass to the next team member. Hilarious and energetic!
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up costume stations for each team
2. Explain relay rules clearly
3. First person dresses up completely
4. Runs to finish line and back
5. Undresses and passes to next teammate
hostScript: Get ready for the silliest race ever! Put on all the costume pieces, race to the line, come back, and pass everything to your teammate!

name: Would You Rather
fullDescription: Pose fun 'would you rather' questions to children and have them choose sides, then discuss their choices. Great for conversation and decision-making skills.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Prepare age-appropriate questions
2. Designate sides of room for choices
3. Read question and options
4. Children choose sides physically
5. Discuss some answers briefly
hostScript: Time for some tough choices! I'll give you two options and you pick which one you'd rather do. Move to the side that matches your choice!

name: Bean Bag Toss
description: Toss bean bags into targets for points
fullDescription: Set up various targets with different point values and let children toss bean bags to score points. Can be themed with special targets and decorations.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up targets at various distances
2. Assign point values to each target
3. Give each child 5 bean bags
4. Keep score of successful tosses
5. Award prizes based on total points
hostScript: Test your aiming skills at our bean bag toss! Each target has different points. Take your time, aim carefully, and see how many points you can score!

name: Nature Scavenger Hunt
description: Find natural items from a checklist
fullDescription: Children search for natural items like leaves, rocks, flowers, or sticks from a provided list. Perfect for outdoor parties and connecting with nature.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Create nature item checklists
2. Set clear search boundaries
3. Give each child collection bag
4. Supervise search activities
5. Share and discuss found items
hostScript: Let's become nature detectives! Look for all the items on your list. Remember to be gentle with nature and only take what you need!

name: Puzzle Station
fullDescription: Set up multiple puzzle stations with different difficulty levels. Children can work individually or in small groups to complete themed jigsaw puzzles.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up puzzle stations with different difficulties
2. Help children choose appropriate puzzles
3. Provide guidance when needed
4. Encourage teamwork on harder puzzles
5. Celebrate completed puzzles
hostScript: Welcome to our puzzle corner! Choose a puzzle that looks fun to you. Work by yourself or team up with friends to solve these brain teasers!

name: Ice Cream Sundae Bar
description: Build your own ice cream sundae
fullDescription: Set up a sundae bar with vanilla ice cream and various toppings like sprinkles, chocolate sauce, whipped cream, cherries, and candies for children to create their perfect treat.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Set up sundae bar with all toppings
2. Give each child a bowl and scoop of ice cream
3. Let children choose their own toppings
4. Help younger children with serving
5. Enjoy sundaes together
hostScript: Welcome to our amazing sundae bar! Start with delicious ice cream and add whatever toppings make you happy. Create the sundae of your dreams!

name: Red Light Green Light
fullDescription: Children move toward a finish line when you say 'Green Light' and must freeze when you say 'Red Light.' Anyone caught moving during red light goes back to start.
stepByStepInstructions:
1. Mark clear start and finish lines
2. Line up children at start
3. Call out 'Green Light' to go
4. Call 'Red Light' to stop
5. First to finish line wins
hostScript: Listen carefully for my signals! Green light means GO - move toward the finish line. Red light means STOP - freeze like a statue!
